result:
QA-29237 is a **PASS**, with one caveat on assertion A6. I ran it as Tuesday's pair: account UCLA, brand "University of California, Los Angeles", Impressions data set, Jan 01–Dec 31 2023, TikTok only, which gave 134 posts.

- **A5, Impressions displays a value:** pass. All 134 posts show a number, and the Sum row shows 30,870,131, which matches the per-post total.
- **A5, en-dash on Organic and Paid Impressions:** pass. All 134 posts show "–" for both.
- **A6, Organic Reach + Paid Reach = Reach:** pass, but vacuous. Reach, Organic Reach and Paid Reach are all "–" on every TikTok post, so there is nothing to sum. If QA expects real Reach numbers for TikTok here, that needs a follow-up.
- **A7, Engagement Rate = Engagements / Impressions × 100:** pass on all 134 posts, within display rounding.

The case's Notes line gives a different Tuesday rotation than its Description table. I followed the Description table, as the earlier cases QA-29234 and QA-29235 did.

The report is at `results/2026-10-20/QA-29237-report.md`, with screenshots in `.playwright-out/QA-29237/`.
